text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Splendid running...
She might just be capable of aiming for the
top...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hah... hah... hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *exhale*...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! 
Yeah, today felt pretty darn good,
didn't it?
choice_data_list: (As expected, her raw ability is h...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That was magnificent!
Especially your speed retention!
Would you like to develop that talent under
my guidance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had seen her being scouted like that
countless times already.
Even to a rookie like me,
it was baffling that she didn't have a
Trainer yet.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—So yeah, I got an offer, but...
I decided to pass on it this time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure you'll find a great mentor!" ...Mhm,
thank you♡
These things really come down to destiny,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's like entrusting your entire active
career to that person.
It's way too important for me to make a
half-hearted choice.

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Stationed...
text_block_list.text:
"At Tracen Academy,
you can't make your debut without a Trainer,
right?
Are you gonna be okay,
Loves-chan? What about your debut timing?"
choice_data_list: If you're aiming for a debut this ...

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Stationed...
text_block_list.text:
"Oh really! Wait, 'Bridge' person,
are you someone in the know?"
choice_data_list: N-No, that's just what I've heard...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I scrambled to cover up my slip.
If my identity gets leaked,
it'll be hard to keep things the way they are.
I need to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day.
Passing by the cafeteria,
I spotted that familiar figure once again.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
having such an accomplished veteran
approach me
is truly an honor.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
With me,
I can take you to the heights you desire.
Why not unleash that talent in graded stakes...
no, on the GⅠ stage?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I turned him down♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Did you have a big reason?" you ask? Hmm...
Well, yeah.
Usually,
anyone would jump at an offer from a GⅠ
Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Looking purely at track records,
I agree it's an offer I definitely should've
taken.
But—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
but I must ask you to shut down that fan
community of yours.
—That is a condition of our contract.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Unnecessary distractions and drama lead to
mental burnout and injuries.
Considering your priorities as an athlete,
you should understand.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I understand what you're saying. But...
it's different for me.
Even if you can't understand why.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—"Excessive interaction with fans isn't
necessary to get stronger."
All the Trainers I've turned down so far
thought more or less the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...
"...Aren't you scared?" ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it,
I had posted that question.
I simply couldn't help asking.
choice_data_list: What if you never find someone who...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"What if you never find someone who
understands?" ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe♪ That question might not even apply
to me.
Because I'm not considering it.
A path where I can't walk together with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time passed after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You still didn't have a
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Are we robbing you of your
opportunities?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on,
"robbing me of opportunities"?
That's not true at all!
I'm making plenty of time for training,
too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—"But if streaming is a ball and chain on
getting a contract"...?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"We'd be okay just watching over you from
afar."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just watching over from afar"...
What do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—"If streaming is what's holding things
up"—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, oh you guys.
You really don't need to worry like that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of Trainers at Tracen
Academy.
It's just that a few of them happened to
have different philosophies from mine.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Say.
Does anyone here...
remember a story from when I was little?

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Today's special event!
The winner of the kids' race is...
Loves Only You-chan!

text_block_list.name: Young Loves
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! 
Daddy~! Mommy~! Did you see that~?!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yes, congratulations on winning♪
Mommy is so, so proud of you, Loves♪

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Honey, look at that smile on Loves! 
Ah, I want so many more people to see this
smile...!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Look here, Loves.
This is that "streaming" you said you wanted
to try.
Try looking right at the camera lens and
saying, ""!

text_block_list.name: Young Loves
text_block_list.text: H-H... el... lo?

text_block_list.name: Young Loves
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! 
Papa!
An exclamation mark popped up right here!

text_block_list.name: Fickle High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
"You may be tiny and cute,
but you're super fast!
I just watched your race,
and I'm officially a fan!"

text_block_list.name: Young Loves
text_block_list.text: A fan...?

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
that just means they really like you!

text_block_list.name: Young Loves
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Man, Loves-chan was so tiny back then"...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah. Takes me back.
...To me,
this is the precious place where I first
met everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And above all else—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's the place where I found my very own
"love."
